rep.name: First turn
rep.challenge: Turn the orange ring until its gap reaches the hook. A ring with nothing left to hold shatters.

rep.name: Held
rep.challenge: Only the last ring turns: the others are held by their own arms. Start at the end of the chain.

rep.name: Flower
rep.challenge: Three petals hook the center. One long turn of the center frees them all at once.

rep.name: Swing
rep.challenge: Free the small ring, then the middle ring carries its arm. One way the arm hits the hook above; turn the other way.

rep.name: Bridge
rep.challenge: The middle ring is closed and cannot let go of anything. Free both sides; it shatters when nothing holds it.

rep.name: Make way
rep.challenge: The right ring cannot finish: its arm runs into the arm of the left ring. Turn the left ring first to clear the path.

rep.name: Slide out
rep.challenge: Two bars run into the gaps of the top and bottom rings, so those rings cannot turn. The frame on the right is in the way of both bars: slide the frame out first, then each bar, then turn the rings.

rep.name: In the way
rep.challenge: The bar runs into the top of the middle ring and can only slide up and out, but the ring above is in its way. Clear the top ring, slide the bar out, then open the middle ring.

rep.name: Two at once
rep.challenge: A bent bar runs into the gaps of the hub and of the lower ring, so neither can turn. It slides out along its pins, but the short bar above is in its way: slide that one up into its ring and out first.

rep.name: Workshop
rep.challenge: Three bars hold three rings. The bent bar cannot slide out while the long bar is in its way, and the long bar cannot slide up while the top ring sits on its path. Clear the top corner, slide the long bar, then the bent bar, then open the hub.
